name: a version badge, a headline and a mode switch
looks: A small rounded version badge pops in above a two-line headline. Underneath, a three-way segmented control shows its active pill sliding from one option to another, and a grid of six icon tiles sits below it holding steady through the switch.
build: Badge scales in (back.out) first; headline fades/rises in; the segmented control's active pill slides to the new option's position and width on power2.inOut, 0.2-0.3s; the icon grid is static, unaffected by the switch.
sound: A light pop on the badge, a soft slide-click as the segmented control's pill moves.
prompt: Pop in a small version badge above a two-line headline, then slide a segmented control's active pill from one option to another underneath, while a steady grid of icon tiles sits below holding through the switch, to prove a setting actually changes the app.
